texts.client_setup_guide: 📌 Client setup ⚙️ Configuration files: Open 📥 Download INCY: Open Short path: simply paste the subscription from our bot into your client and the VPN will work. The detailed guide below is only needed if you want to configure routing and application proxying. INCY (recommended) 1. Download the INCY file for your operating system. 2. Open INCY. 3. Paste the subscription from our bot. 4. Optional: "Settings" → "Backup" → "Select file", choose the previously downloaded config from the configuration post, then "Replace" and "Apply". 5. Optional: "Settings" → "Proxy by application" and select all pro-Russian applications that do not work with VPN. Happ 1. Download Happ for your operating system. 2. Open Happ. 3. Paste the subscription from our bot. 4. Optionally configure routing and application proxying in the "Settings" section. v2RayTun (outdated core, issues possible) 1. Download the v2RayTun file. 2. Open v2RayTun. 3. Paste the subscription from our bot. 4. Optional: "Settings" → "App settings" → "Restore settings", choose the previously downloaded config from the configuration post. 5. Optional: "Settings" → "Routing" and select all pro-Russian applications that do not work with VPN. ℹ️ For help with another client or additional help with INCY, Happ and v2RayTun, contact support. ⚠️ Important: We use XRay 26.11.9+ (3X-UI 3.11.0) with XHTTP transport and REALITY plugin.
